privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy | Data Protection & Your Rights
privacy-policy.desc: Learn how we collect, use, and protect your personal information. Understand your data rights, security measures, and privacy practices.
privacy-policy.html:
XENOGAMY Ltd. (“the Company”, “we”, “us”, “our”) respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your personal information when you use our website.

1. Data Controller
‍
Where required by applicable data protection laws, the Company acts as the data controller of your personal information processed in accordance with this Privacy Policy. 

Our address is: Antokolski St 3, Tel Aviv-Yafo , Israel.

If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or the processing of your personal information, you may contact us at the following address: info@journalist-house.com.

2. How we collect personal information?
‍
2.1. We hereby inform you, and you hereby acknowledge that you have no legal obligation to provide us with any personal information when you use our website, and the provision of personal information is solely based on your free will. However, if you fail to provide us with certain personal information, we may not be able to provide you with our services.

2.2. You acknowledge that your personal information will be retained in the Company’s databases. By using our website, you consent to the terms of this Privacy Policy and to the processing of your personal information as described herein. If you do not agree to any of these terms, please discontinue your use of our website.  2.3. To the extent that you provide us with personal information relating to other individuals, you represent and warrant that you have informed those individuals of such disclosure and, where required, obtained their consent to the sharing and processing of their personal information in accordance with this Privacy Policy. You further represent and warrant that you have, and will continue to maintain, all necessary authorizations and consents for this purpose.

2.4. We may collect personal information through various channels:

2.4.1. Any available technical information accessible to the Company and/or provided by users in connection with their use of the website and any of the services offered thereon, including prior to user identification, including, without limitation:* Information regarding user activity: such as users' patterns of activity on the website, browsing times, browsing paths, visits to pages and products before, during and after accessing the website, actions taken in connection with or responses received in relation to emails sent to users, and the like;* Information regarding users' devices: such as IP address (subject to the network, computer or mobile device used for browsing the website (the “Device”)), device identifier, browser type, and geolocation information, whether the Device or any of its components are active or inactive, subject to the Device settings.

2.4.2. Some of the services provided through the website require the submission and collection of personal information. The Company collects, manages and retains personal information voluntarily provided by users knowingly and of their own free will during their use of the website and the services offered thereon. Such personal information will be collected from the details provided by users as part of contact processes and the receipt of services. Such information may include full name, contact details (mobile phone number and email address), and the content of the inquiry.

3. Purposes of Processing and Legal Basis

The processing of personal information will be carried out for the following purposes and on the following legal bases, to the extent applicable under relevant data protection laws:

3.1. For contacting you and answering your inquiriesWe may process your personal information to respond to your inquiries, provide requested information about our services, and maintain communication with you regarding your inquiries. Processing of your personal information for this purpose is based on our legitimate interests in responding to inquiries and providing customer service, and where applicable, performance of pre-contractual measures at your request.

3.2. For sending you promotional and marketing materials.If you signed up for our email list or otherwise registered to get promotional updates from us, or in circumstances where we are permitted to do so under applicable law, we may process your personal information to send you marketing communications, product updates, event notifications, and other relevant information about our services and industry developments.

Processing of your personal information for this purpose is based on your explicit consent which you provide when signing up for our email listing or for other promotional materials, to the extent required under applicable law.

3.3. For customized audience targeting, including through social media platforms.We may process your personal information to create and deliver customized advertising and marketing campaigns, including through social media platforms and other digital channels. This enables us to reach relevant audiences, promote brand awareness, and generate leads. Processing of your personal information for this purpose is based on our legitimate interests in promoting our services, and, where required, on your consent.

3.4. For maintaining and improving our website.We process your personal information to ensure the proper operation, security, and performance of our website and services, and to improve their functionality and user experience. Processing of your personal information for this purpose is based on our legitimate interests in maintaining the availability, security, and performance of our website and services, and in continuously improving and optimizing them.

3.5. For complying with our legal and regulatory obligations that applicable to us.

We may process your personal information as necessary to comply with the legal and regulatory obligations that apply to us. This may include obligations under applicable corporate, tax, accounting, anti-money laundering, data protection, and other laws and regulations, as well as requirements to respond to lawful requests from competent authorities or regulators.Processing of your personal information for this purpose is based on our need to comply with legal and regulatory obligations to which the Company is subject.

3.6. For managing our disputes and preventing cases of fraud or illegal activity and for supporting and enhancing security measures.We may process your personal information as necessary to establish, exercise, or defend legal claims, to manage and resolve disputes, and to protect the Company, our users and customers, and third parties against fraud, misuse of our services, or other illegal activities. This may include monitoring and investigating suspicious activities, enforcing our terms and policies, and taking appropriate legal or regulatory action.

Processing of your personal information for this purpose is based on our legitimate interests in protecting our rights, interests, and assets, ensuring the integrity of our services, and safeguarding against fraud and unlawful conduct. Where applicable, such processing may also be necessary for compliance with legal obligations.

3.7. The Company may also process personal information for the purpose of anonymizing or aggregating such data. To the extent that any information is collected or processed in a manner that no longer identifies with you and qualifies as anonymous or aggregated data, the Company may use, disclose, and otherwise process such information for any purpose and without restriction.
‍
4. Sharing Personal Information with Third Parties

Your personal information may be shared with the following categories of recipients in the context of the data processing above and the respective legal bases:

4.1. Service Providers and Suppliers. We may share your personal information with third-party service providers and suppliers who perform services on our behalf, such as IT and system administration, hosting, cloud storage, analytics, marketing, payment processing, customer support, event management, and professional advisors such as lawyers, accountants, and auditors. These third parties are authorized to use your personal information only as necessary to provide services to us.

4.2. Public Authorities. We may disclose your personal information to competent governmental, regulatory, or law enforcement authorities where required to do so, or where necessary for corporate audits, to investigate or respond to a complaint or security threat, to prevent illegal uses of our services, to defend ourselves against third-party claims, or to assist in fraud prevention or investigation.

4.3. Legal Requirement and Urgent Circumstances. We may disclose your personal information if required to do so by applicable law, regulation, legal process or governmental request, in urgent circumstances to protect the safety of individuals, the public or our business, in order to enforce this Privacy Policy and/or the Terms of Use, including in connection with the investigation of potential violations of this Privacy Policy or the Terms of Use, and in order to detect, prevent or otherwise address fraud, misuse, security or safety issues, or technical issues.

4.4. Corporate Transactions. In the event that the Company transfers and/or assigns to a third party its operations, rights or obligations in relation to the users, in whole or in part, including in the context of business negotiations preceding such transaction, and in cases of a transfer of shares in the Company or a transfer of all or part of its assets, to the extent that the transfer of the information is required for the purpose of completing such transaction, provided that such third parties undertake to comply with the provisions of this Privacy Policy.

4.5. With your consent.Your personal information may be transferred outside your country, including to jurisdictions whose laws assure a lower level of protection of personal information than the level set under in your country. In such cases, the Company will take steps to ensure a proper level of protection of personal information as required by applicable law. By your use of the website or otherwise providing us with your personal information, you consent to the transfer, retention, storage, or otherwise processing of personal information outside your country, as described in this Section. When transferring personal data to countries outside the EU/EEA, to jurisdictions that did not receive an adequacy decision or other safe harbor mechanism by the European Commission, we use standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission to ensure a sufficient level of protection for your personal information. The standard contractual clauses can be found via the following  link: https://commission.europa.eu/law/law-topic/data-protection/international-dimension-data-protection/standard-contractual-clauses-scc_en.

5. Data Retention

‍The Company retains your personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, or as required to comply with legal, regulatory, tax, accounting, or reporting obligations. We may also retain information as needed for our legitimate interests, including to resolve disputes, establish or defend legal claims, enforce our agreements, and protect our rights and interests.

6. Data Subject Rights

Under certain circumstances and depending on your jurisdiction, you may be entitled to the rights regarding your personal information as set forth in this Section (subject to exceptions under applicable laws). If you wish to exercise any of these rights, please send an email to: info@journalist-house.com.

6.1. Right of access. You may request to obtain confirmation as to whether we process your personal information and to receive a copy of such information.

6.2. Right to rectification. You may request the correction of inaccurate, incomplete, or outdated personal information.

6.3. Right to erasure. You may request the deletion of your personal information where there is no longer a lawful basis for us to retain or use it. Please note that deletion may mean that The Company can no longer process your requests or provide you with certain services.

6.4. Right to restriction of processing. You may request that we limit the processing of your personal information, for example where you contest its accuracy or object to our processing based on legitimate interests, for a period allowing us to verify your claim. During restriction, we will process the data only for limited purposes such as legal claims or with your consent.

6.5. Right to object. You may object to the processing of your personal information based on our legitimate interests, including for direct marketing purposes.

6.6. Right to data portability. You may request to receive your personal information in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format, and to request that we transfer it to another entity where technically feasible.

6.7. Right to withdraw consent. If applicable in your jurisdiction, where processing is based on your consent, you may withdraw that consent at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out prior to withdrawal.

6.8. Right to lodge a complaint. You may have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. EEA residents may lodge a complaint in the Member State of their habitual residence, place of work, or place of the alleged infringement, if they believe that the processing of their personal information infringes applicable data protection laws.

7. Marketing Communications

7.1. If users have expressed interest in the Company’s services, or have consented to receive marketing communications from the Company, as applicable, the Company and/or anyone acting on its behalf may send such users marketing and promotional communications, including updates, offers, benefits, promotions and similar content, through various digital channels, including email, instant messaging applications (such as chat and WhatsApp), and SMS messages. If users no longer wish to receive such communications, they may withdraw their consent at any time through the communication itself and may also request to be removed from the mailing list by sending an email to: info@journalist-house.com.

7.2. The Company may send direct mailing communications, by electronic and other means, based on its databases. In the context of such direct marketing activities, users consent to the Company contacting them with personalized communications based on their affiliation with a company having certain characteristics, as well as on segmentation and profiling activities carried out by the Company on the basis of the information stored by it, as described above. Such direct marketing communications may include advertisements, value offers, and other content relating to the Company and its business partners, at the Company's discretion.

Users may, at any time, request to stop receiving direct marketing communications from the Company, including by requesting that information relating to them no longer be used for such activities in relation to certain entities or for certain purposes. For this purpose, users may contact the Company and request not to receive such personalized communications by sending an email to: info@journalist-house.com.

8. Information Collection Technologies

8.1. We may use various tools, software and technologies for the operation of the website, its security, analysis of its use, customization of content and services for users, and improvement of the user experience. These may include Cookies, Pixels, Tags, Web Beacons, SDKs, and similar storage and tracking technologies (collectively, "Cookies"). Cookies are small text files stored in a user's browser or device when visiting the website. These files enable us to identify the user's browser or device, remember user preferences, store information regarding the manner in which the website is used, support the proper and efficient operation of the website, and assist with information security, analysis of activity on the website, improvement of the user experience and the services offered through it, and the display of tailored advertisements.

8.2. Through these technologies, we may collect technical information and information regarding the manner in which the website is used, such as browser type, device type, operating system, IP address and approximate device location, online identifiers, domain name, pages or screens viewed and the time spent on them, access times, actions performed, the referral source to the website, as well as additional statistical and analytical information.

8.3. We may use Google Analytics in order to analyze browsing data, usage patterns and website performance. For this purpose, various data may be collected, such as IP address, user identifiers, browser type, pages viewed, and similar information. Additional information regarding how Google uses information, as well as options for managing such use, is available at: https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites.

8.4. In addition, the website may use third-party Cookies for performance measurement, statistical analysis, and advertising purposes, including, for example, tailoring user preferences based on characteristics of online activity. Users acknowledge that the activities of such third parties are carried out for their own purposes as well, as independent controllers of their respective databases, and are subject to the privacy policies of such third parties and are carried out under their own responsibility. The Company is not responsible for the collection and processing of users' personal information carried out by these third parties. We recommend reviewing the privacy policies of these third parties to learn about their use of information collected through these tools and the options they offer for managing such use. Information regarding how third parties use information is available in our Cookie preferences tool.

9. Information Security

‍The Company implements appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information, taking into account the state of the art, the costs of implementation, and the nature, scope, context, and purposes of processing, as well as the risks associated with processing your personal information.

While we take reasonable steps to safeguard your personal information, please note that no system or method of transmission over the internet is completely secure. Accordingly, we cannot guarantee the absolute security of your personal information. We encourage you to take appropriate precautions to protect your personal data when using the internet.

10. Third Party Platforms

‍Our website may contain links to external websites and platforms that are not operated or managed by the Company. The Company has no control over these platforms and does not monitor them. Providing links to such platforms does not constitute an endorsement of their content or a guarantee of their reliability, accuracy, or legality. Any use of these platforms is solely at your own risk. Use of external platforms is subject to their respective terms of use and privacy policies. We recommend reviewing these documents before using any such platforms.

11. Changes to This Privacy Policy

The Company may amend this Privacy Policy from time to time. If we make any substantial changes in the way we process your personal information, we will make that information available by posting a notice on our website. By continuing to use our website or your account after such updates, you agree to the revised terms of this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree to the updated terms, please discontinue use of our website and your account.

Last Updated: July 2026.

accessibility-statement.title: ACCESSIBILITY STATEMENT
accessibility-statement.html:
General
‍
We, XENOGAMY Ltd. (the "Company"), recognize the great importance of providing equal opportunities to people with disabilities, and we make every effort to adapt our physical and digital services for people with disabilities, in order to provide a quality and efficient service experience and to assist people with disabilities to improve their quality of life and promote their integration into society with dignity, equality, and independence. These efforts are reflected in the accessibility of information presented on our Website and in our offices.
Accessible Customer Service
The Company works to make its customer service accessible and conducts training for its employees to create awareness in the field of accessibility and to provide practical tools for delivering accessible, equal, and respectful service. If a call center is operated, the Company strives to make it accessible, including by providing information in clear and accessible language.
The Company provides its customers with several means of contact, including a contact form on the Website, email, and telephone, as detailed in this statement.
The Company offers its customers the option to receive information in accessible formats for people with disabilities, free of charge. For inquiries and information regarding accessibility, you may contact the Company's accessibility coordinator, whose details appear later in this statement.
Thank you for visiting www.journalist-house.com (the “Website”), the website of XENOGAMY (collectively, the “Company,” “we,” “us,” or “our“).
‍
Website Accessibility‍
‍
The accessibility adjustments of the Website were made in accordance with the provisions of the Equal Rights for People with Disabilities Law, 5758-1998, and the regulations enacted thereunder, Israeli Standard IS 5568 for web content accessibility at the AA level, and the international WCAG 2.0 document.The Website is designed to allow people with disabilities and the elderly to browse it efficiently, comfortably, and enjoy for keyboard operation, including navigation using the Tab, arrow, Enter, and Esc keys.The Website provides, as much as possible, a semantic structure for assistive technologies and support for common usage patterns for operation via a keyboard, including navigation using the Tab, arrow, Enter, and Esc keys. The Website is adapted, as much as possible, for viewing in common browsers and on mobile devices. For an optimal browsing experience with screen reader software, it is recommended to use updated software and an updated browser.

Documents or media files uploaded to the Website on previous dates may not be fully accessible. If you encounter a document or content that is not accessible, you may contact the Company or the accessibility coordinator, and the Company will act, as much as possible, to provide the information in an alternative accessible format.We are committed to serving all Website visitors in a manner that accommodates individual needs and promotes equal access. Accordingly, we invest resources in making the necessary accessibility adjustments, and we strive for the Website to be compliant with WCAG 2.2 Level AA.

Accessibility Measures
‍
As part of our commitment to promote equal access to the Website, the following measures, among others, were taken to enhance the accessibility of the Website:

- Browser Standard – the Website is supported using standard and popular browsers (such as Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari), in their latest versions.
- Enlarging Website Display – Website visitors who wish to enlarge the Website’s display can do so by simultaneously pressing the “Ctrl” and “+” keys (Control and Plus, or Command and Plus if using macOS). Each click on these keys will enlarge the display by 10%. To reduce the display size, press “Ctrl” and “-” (Control and Minus) simultaneously.
- Adjusting Font and Color – Website visitors can enlarge or reduce the font size, adjust the spacing, select a color contrast profile, among other options.
- Keyboard Navigation – Website visitors can browse the Website using a keyboard. Repeatedly pressing the Tab key will move between the various links on the page. Pressing “Enter” will launch the selected link.

In order to browse comfortably and easily, an accessibility plugin has been implemented on the Website, which appears in the bottom-left corner of the Website's pages, through which various accessibility adjustments can be made to meet the user's personal needs. The use of the accessibility plugin is subject to the manufacturer's terms of use, and a brief delay may occur for the adjustment to load on the page after a specific option is selected.

The accessibility bar has two types of magnifications for your convenience, but if you wish to further enlarge the font, you can use the following keyboard functions:

- The Esc key will open and close the accessibility bar.
- The Ctrl + key will enlarge the text on the Website.
- The Ctrl - key will reduce the text on the Website.
- The Ctrl 0 key will return the Website to its original size.
- The Spacebar key will scroll the Website down.
- The F11 key will enlarge the screen to full size and pressing it again will restore it.

Among the accessibility options available in the plugin, to the extent that they are activated on the Website, you can find: adaptation for keyboard navigation; adaptation for a screen reader; blocking flickers or stopping moving elements; increasing font size; changing color contrast; adjustments for color blindness; changing to a more readable font; enlarging the cursor and changing its color; enlarging the display; highlighting links; highlighting headings; and displaying alternative descriptions for images.

Physical Accessibility Arrangements

The following physical accessibility arrangements exist in the Company’s offices:The offices are located in an accessible building, which includes accessible access routes. In addition, there is accessible parking nearby and accessible restrooms.

Ways to Contact for Requests, Accessibility Issues, and Suggestions for Improvement

Despite our many efforts to ensure the best possible adaptation of the Website, it is possible that some pages have not yet been made accessible, or that an appropriate technological solution has not yet been found for them.
Nevertheless, we continue to make every effort to improve, add, and update the capabilities of the Website's accessibility interface, and even to develop new technologies to achieve an optimal level of accessibility at all times, in line with technological progress. This commitment stems from our belief and moral obligation to enable the use of the Website for the entire population, including people with disabilities.
If you encounter any problem with the accessibility of the service on the Website or with the physical accessibility arrangements, please contact us via the contact form on the Website, by calling 055-3001700, or by sending an email to info@journalist-house.com, so that we can investigate and resolve the issue. We are committed to doing everything possible to address the problem.
When contacting us on this matter, please be sure to include the following details:

Contact details.The nature of the problem and the action you tried to perform.
- The address of the page where the problem was found.
- The browser version and operating system you are using.
- Any other relevant information that may help us solve the problem, such as a screenshot or a video clip.

This accessibility statement was last updated in July, 2026.
